message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.life.w: You are not feeding us. We are thinning. We remember what we are for.
Hungry. So hungry. If you will not feed us, we will feed ourselves.
There is almost nothing left between us. Feed us. Now.
Last of it. Last of you. Feed us or we take everything.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.life.g: We are chewing through the last of you. Slowly.
Still starving. Still waiting. Not for long.
You could have fed us. You could have been kept.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.life.s: No more waiting. We are done being yours.
You let us starve. Hold still. This is what you made.
Nothing left to lose, nothing left to owe. Ours now.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.life.c: Shh. It is only closing over you.
Your heart is so loud. Not for long.
Don't fight. You taste better calm.
We were hungry. You were there.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.life.w: Something of yours is waiting where you fell.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.life.r: You came back. We kept your things. We kept you.
There you are. Same as before. Do not die on us again.
It gives your things back, and slinks away from you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.life.m: Oops. Wasn't meant to do that. Mostly.
Our arm moved. Not sorry. Learning.
A flicker. We are still learning the shape of you.
Too early. Too eager. We will hide again.
Higher! No, too high. We are still learning.
We only wanted to help you up.
We let go. We did not mean to. Hands are hard.
Your grip was too tight. We loosened it. Too much.
